hook.name: VoraxHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Vorax launchpad hook that applies asymmetric static LP fees based on swap direction (vorax token vs. paired token), collects a 20% protocol fee via BeforeSwap/AfterSwap delta manipulation, optionally runs a MEV protection module active for 2 minutes post-creation, and auto-claims LP locker fees on each swap.
